name: vizier-guard

tools.name: vizier_screen_action
tools.description: Screen and authorize a proposed AI agent action before execution. Evaluates deterministic policy constraints, DLP leakage, loop prevention, and returns an ALLOW / REVIEW / BLOCK decision with an auditable cryptographic receipt.

target.description: Exact target resource URI or identifier (e.g. 'mcp://github/create_issue', 'stripe://charges', 'bash://rm', 'https://api.example.com').

parameters.description: Arguments or payload of the proposed action.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent requesting action.

principal_id.description: Identifier of the human operator or principal.

tools.name: vizier_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a cryptographic receipt or audit proof issued by Vizier. Validates token structure, expiration, and exact request/action hash binding.

receipt.description: The receipt token string (JWS compact or receipt JSON) issued by Vizier.

expected_action_type.description: Optional expected action type to verify against the receipt.

expected_target.description: Optional expected target URI to verify against the receipt.

tools.name: vizier_check_policy
tools.description: Check content or parameters against security guardrails (DLP credential/PII leaks, sanctions screening, or circuit breaker loop limits).

content.description: Text string, parameters object, or entity name to screen.

instructions: Vizier is a deterministic authorization kernel. Call 'vizier_screen_action' before high-stakes operations (e.g. bash commands, file modifications, external writes, payments) to obtain cryptographic ALLOW/BLOCK receipts. Call 'vizier_verify_receipt' to validate proof of compliance. Call 'vizier_check_policy' to screen parameters or text for DLP secrets and sanctions.
